IF F5755050520000, SEE F5755565900051: MODIFICATION 46720 (H13777) INTRODUCED A REVISED AILERON ACTUATOR SEAL DESIGN CONFIGURED AS A ONE PIECE ITEM REPLACING EARLIER AILERON ACTUATOR MULTIPLE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLIES. CONCURRENTLY, THE AILERON BLADE SEALS WHICH ARE FITTED ADJACENT TO THE ACTUATOR SEALS, WERE ALSO MODIFIED BY LENGTHENING THE SEAL TO CORRECTLY FIT AGAINST THE NEW ACTUATOR SEALS. SHOULD AN OPERATOR OF A PRE MOD 46720 AIRCRAFT NEED TO ORDER EITHER A COMPLETE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY OR AN INDIVIDUAL FINGER SEAL, A POST MOD 46720 ONE PIECE SEAL CAN BE FITTED WITH THE EXISTING AILERON BLADE SEALS. NOTE, IF A PRE MOD 46720 CLOSING FINGER OR CENTRAL FINGER IS REQUIRED, THEN REFERENCE TO THE SPECIFIC FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY IS REQUIRED IN ORDER TO ENABLE SUPPLY OF THE CORRECT POST MOD 46720 SEAL ASSEMBLY. THE PREFERRED, BUT NOT MANDATORY SOLUTION WOULD BE TO REPLACE THE PRE MOD 46720 FINGER SEALS AND BLADE SEALS WITH A COMPLETE SET OF POST MOD ONE PIECE ACTUATOR AND ADJACENT BLADE SEALS (3 BLADE SEALS AND 2 ACTUATOR SEALS PER AILERON).

MODIFICATION 46720 (H13777) INTRODUCED A REVISED AILERON ACTUATOR SEAL DESIGN CONFIGURED AS A ONE PIECE ITEM REPLACING EARLIER AILERON ACTUATOR MULTIPLE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLIES. CONCURRENTLY, THE AILERON BLADE SEALS WHICH ARE FITTED ADJACENT TO THE ACTUATOR SEALS, WERE ALSO MODIFIED BY LENGTHENING THE SEAL TO CORRECTLY FIT AGAINST THE NEW ACTUATOR SEALS. SHOULD AN OPERATOR OF A PRE MOD 46720 AIRCRAFT NEED TO ORDER EITHER A COMPLETE FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY OR AN INDIVIDUAL FINGER SEAL, A POST MOD 46720 ONE PIECE SEAL CAN BE FITTED WITH THE EXISTING AILERON BLADE SEALS. NOTE, IF A PRE MOD 46720 CLOSING FINGER OR CENTRAL FINGER IS REQUIRED, THEN REFERENCE TO THE SPECIFIC FINGER SEAL ASSEMBLY IS REQUIRED IN ORDER TO ENABLE SUPPLY OF THE CORRECT POST MOD 46720 SEAL ASSEMBLY. THE PREFERRED, BUT NOT MANDATORY SOLUTION WOULD BE TO REPLACE THE PRE MOD 46720 FINGER SEALS AND BLADE SEALS WITH A COMPLETE SET OF POST MOD ONE PIECE ACTUATOR AND ADJACENT BLADE SEALS (3 BLADE SEALS AND 2 ACTUATOR SEALS PER AILERON).
